newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI BOURSE CLOSED FOR QUEEN SIRIKIT'S BIRTHDAY.
newsitem.headline: THAI BOURSE CLOSED FOR QUEEN SIRIKIT'S BIRTHDAY.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange closed on Tuesday to celebrate Queen Sirikit's birthday.

A $16 billion international pledge of loans for helping Thailand ride out its financial problems failed to rally the market on Monday when the composite SET index finished off 4.60 points at 632.25 on thin 2.82 billion baht turnover.
The SET-50 index was down 0.31 points to 47.86.
